0.0: #m104000000# is a serene area, always peaceful. The sea around here is likewise very calm. The ocean that connects the Maple Island and the Victoria Island is calm and peaceful. It's a haven for all the fishermen around the area.
0.1: But for me, the true descendent of the Viking, #m104000000# is nothing but an empty space. A true Lord of the Sea longs for treacherous winds and overcoming huge tidal waves and rainstorms to emerge victorious! I truly believe tornadoes and storms are there for people like me to endure! I mean, you are a traveler, you know exactly what I am talking about, right?

yes.0: But the Tornado Sea on Ossyria is way too treacherous for anyone to enter. It would be of great help if I could find someone who is very familiar with the Sea, but the only ones that really are familiar are the #rpirates of the Lord Pirate#k. Lord Pirate possesses the #t4001119# that has a path drawn on the Tornado Sea, supposedly the only path that enables the sailors to navigate through the treacherous sea. So lucky!
